# `mcp-scaffold init`

- **Usage**: `mcp-scaffold init [FLAGS] [target]`

Fresh scaffold into <target> (defaults to cwd)

## Arguments

### `[target]`

Target directory (defaults to cwd)

## Flags

### `--name <name>`

Tool name (kebab-case, BARE — no -mcp suffix)

### `--scope <scope>`

Npm scope, with leading @

### `--package-manager <pm>`

pnpm | npm | bun

**Choices:**

- `pnpm`
- `npm`
- `bun`

### `--no-tui`

Skip the Ink/React TUI surface

### `--no-http`

Skip the Streamable HTTP transport

### `--no-rust-accel`

Skip the optional Rust acceleration crate

### `--no-semantic-release`

Skip the semantic-release workflow
